decisions.title: Separate worker settings and execution pins from core UI/voice composition
decisions.alreadyWorks: Core and worker derive one sealed source/configuration release and retain immutable original grants.
decisions.gap: Worker imports RuntimeSettings from the full runtime module with core/FastAPI/UI/voice imports. Digital _SOURCES hashes all runtime.py bytes including unrelated UI and voice composition, so those edits change executable release compatibility.
decisions.boundedChange: Extract RuntimeSettings and exactly its eight environment helpers into one configuration module; migrate its direct consumers. Preserve full digital executable/configuration source binding while narrowing only proven unrelated composition pins. Keep the existing runtime facade and one worker lifecycle.
decisions.transition: Preserve strict file-only secrets, validation, original old grants and retained/read compatibility. No implicit old-work resumption or weaker release check; version incompatible execution releases. Coordinate voice seams with their executor.
decisions.doneWhen: Worker settings no longer import UI/voice composition; identical real core/worker inputs yield identical release. UI-only edits do not change digital release while digital executable/config changes still do; old retained tasks remain inspectable with unchanged grants.
decisions.verificationAtE4: Focused existing settings/source-pin/admission/resume/read checks and one relevant native digital route. No tests/runtime calls run in this review.
decisions.risk: A broad pin cannot simply be removed: all genuinely executed sources must stay sealed.

decisions.title: Adapter-owned completion/readback evidence for the generic digital worker
decisions.alreadyWorks: The shared task loop checks current authorization, deadline, stop, budgets and durable indexed tool receipts, rejecting discovery-only results and pending automation readback.
decisions.gap: Generic completion code parses HA REST automation paths/inventory responses plus component selection/document, procedure and programming receipt details. This is adapter protocol knowledge in the general runner.
decisions.boundedChange: Use explicit completion/readback evidence from the existing participating adapters; replace protocol-specific runner parsers with an evidence check. Follow only the necessary adapter contracts under E3.3; no new platform or second executor.
decisions.transition: Preserve old receipt/source/spec/result/time binding, no-replay, cancellation and unknown metering. Tool schema/discovery, HTTP acknowledgement and model final text remain insufficient business-success evidence.
decisions.doneWhen: No HA resource parser or per-provider completion branch remains in the generic runner; discovery/read failure/readback/component-save/running-program cases retain honest existing outcomes via adapters. Semantic verification remains an explicit nonclaim.
decisions.verificationAtE4: Existing targeted receipt/runner regressions and one affected digital route; no new general benchmark series.
decisions.risk: A generic verified transport status alone must never replace the richer current evidence gate.

decisions.title: Reconcile delegated provider pins and dedicated worker build metadata
decisions.alreadyWorks: Active provider source expects OpenAI 3.6.0 and pydantic-ai-slim 2.37.0; its declared engine lock hash exactly matches requirements-4d.lock. Root rechecked core/worker identities against E3.1, allowing existing installed source evidence reuse.
decisions.gap: Dedicated worker roots/lock pin pydantic-ai-slim 2.32.1. Its Dockerfile copies the lock to /opt/eva/requirements-delegated-work.lock but pip refers to /opt/eva/deploy/requirements-delegated-work.lock. Source-refresh copies only src over a proven image.
decisions.boundedChange: E3.3/E4.4 must identify the supported current worker build/dependency authority, then correct exact path/version metadata or explicitly classify the old route as proven replaced. No current image/configuration change for this review.
decisions.transition: Use actual current image/configuration, retain data and parallel voice work, preserve historical lock/error evidence. Do not assume a routine rebuild is required.
decisions.doneWhen: One supported reproducible worker build route agrees with provider version checks and actual copied inputs, or a proven replacement is documented and the old route is no longer presented as current.
decisions.verificationAtE4: Targeted selected build-input/provider compatibility and necessary worker import/readiness only.
decisions.risk: This static discrepancy does not prove the installed worker is broken.

decisions.title: Keep contact-only Sol separate from substantive public-source lookup
decisions.alreadyWorks: Existing lookup preserves current authority, durable model usage, short source-limited output and direct-answer evidence guards.
decisions.gap: Factory selects conversation_contact_model/effort for substantive web source interpretation. Existing test expects gpt-6-sol/none. Current policy reserves Sol/none for simple contact and requires Astra at least medium for substantive work; coordinator confirmed no later exception is known.
decisions.boundedChange: Coordinate existing dirty voice integration with its executor: contact/intent/tool-name selection may use Sol, but substantive source request/interpretation must use the configured authorized work model. Reuse existing lookup, source receipts, original result binding and request journal.
decisions.transition: No voice source/install takeover in this review; preserve lookup tool and direct-reply compatibility.
decisions.doneWhen: Simple contact/planner selection and actual substantive model execution honor the owner policy while existing source/authority/accounting guards remain.
decisions.verificationAtE4: Targeted factory policy and original-ingress/direct-answer/accounting checks coordinated with voice executor; latency/cost changes only when measured.
decisions.risk: Model selection affects latency/usage; no unmeasured gain or failure is claimed.
